name: Jeff
author: Bonfire STACK
tagline: grey pads, green LCD, golden-era boom bap
description: Classic late-80s sampling-drum-machine feel: warm grey plastic, soft grey rubber pads that glow red, a yellow-green LCD with dark pixels, black knurled knobs and red transport accents.
css: .mod-name{font-weight:700;font-style:italic;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.06em}.lcd{text-shadow:none;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 0 2px #2a2a2c,0 1px 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.25)}.step,.cell{background:linear-gradient(#dcd9d0,#bdbab1);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #8a877f,0 3px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:5px}.cell.beat{background:linear-gradient(#cfccc3,#b0ada4)}.step:active,.cell:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #8a877f,inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.cell.on,.step.on{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,#ffd2c8,#ff6a50 55%,#d42a20);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #8a2018,0 0 10px rgba(255,58,34,.55)}.step em,.cell em{color:#26262a}.w-scope-wrap::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:4px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.06) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.06) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);box-shadow:inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}.w-scope-wrap:fullscreen::after{border-radius:0}.code{font-size:17px;line-height:1.3}.tk-com{font-style:normal}.brand img{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.8)) drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8))}.rack-row{background:rgba(20,18,16,.4)}
